text:
dana: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in SCIM deprovisions for multiple customers after yesterday's RBAC attribute mapping change. Several AAD tenants report users removed from infra-admins.

mike: saw it too. example from acme-prod SCIM log:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z scim_event deprovision user=jsmith action=delete reason=attr_match entitlements=["infra-admins"]
```
Notably the incoming entitlement claim was `roles:infra_admin` but our mapping changed to `entitlement` so duplicates matched.

elaine: also correlated with KMS errors in idp service: 
```
ERROR idp.kms Decrypt failed for key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/idp/cryptoKeys/rot1: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED: wrong key
```
When decrypt fails we treat proof-of-possession as invalid and trigger deprovision fallback.

dana: oh — so two independent regressions aligned. Did the key rotation happen at 13:55?

mike: yes, key rotation completed at 2026-03-15T13:56:03. Rotation introduced a new alias but the idp service still requested the old key version in the envelope.

security-bot: alert: SAML assertion audience mismatch from tenant acme-prod (5 occurrences) — see /alerts/2032

sue: customers DM'ing support. We should pause auto-deprovisioning until fix is live.

elaine: agreed. Temporary mitigations I'm applying now:
- disable SCIM auto-deprovision for affected orgs
- queue a full resync
- reconfigure idp service to use new kms alias (idp-main:alias/rot1)

mike: commands I ran:
```
# disable auto-deprov flag
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/orgs/acme-prod/settings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scim_auto_deprov":false}'
# trigger resync
curl -s -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/scim/sync?org=acme-prod" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

dana: good. For postmortem: timeline, root causes (attribute mapping deploy + key alias mismatch), blast radius, remediation (stronger CI for idp key rotation, integration test for attribute mapping), and follow-up owner?

mike: I'll own the key rotation CI + immediate patch. elaine will own roll-back/hunt and postmortem writeup.

elaine: starting draft of incident notes. I'll add logs and affected org list.

sue: I'll coordinate customer comms and draft status update.

dana: thanks all. leaving this thread open until postmortem link posted. :white_check_mark:
